title: Transcription Service Bootstrap
requirements: Build a single shared TranscriptionService at app launch with a WhisperClient(apiKey:) constructed from the Keychain API key; when no key is set, whisperClient is nil and Whisper fallback is skipped gracefully (not a crash)
Inject the shared TranscriptionService via @Environment or an AppEnvironment into RecordingViewModel, EntryDetailViewModel, and any consuming view (not a default-constructed per-VM service)

When the user edits the API key in SettingsView and commits (.onSubmit / Save button — not per keystroke), rebuild the underlying WhisperClient and replace the one inside the shared TranscriptionService (or create a new TranscriptionService instance and propagate)

Make TranscriptSettings the single source of truth for API-key presence and transcription toggles; SettingsViewModel.transcriptionSettings must not be a fresh TranscriptSettings() each run — wire it to the persisted settings (see transcript-settings-persistence)
With an API key set and Speech disabled/failed, transcription succeeds via Whisper (integration path validated end-to-end)
acceptance_criteria: A non-nil Keychain API key results in a WhisperClient-backed TranscriptionService at app startup
Editing the API key and pressing Save reloads the Whisper client without restarting the app
Transcription succeeds via Whisper when Speech is unavailable or disabled and a key is present
out_of_scope: Multiple simultaneous Whispers for different accounts
